title: Legal Operations Associate
description: Support high-volume legal department workflows, vendor coordination, process automation, and operational performance reporting across corporate clients.
requirements: Bachelor's degree in legal studies, business, or related field; 1-3 years experience in legal operations, project coordination, or corporate legal support; familiarity with legal tech workflows and process mapping.

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: Analyze, structure, and process complex multi-terabyte data collections for corporate legal departments, compliance audits, and litigation readiness.
requirements: Strong background in structured data analysis, SQL/Python data manipulation, experience handling forensic images or high-density document collections, and meticulous attention to data integrity.

title: eDiscovery Analyst
description: Execute forensically defensible data ingestion, processing, indexing, Continuous Active Learning (CAL) analytics, and court-ready production generation on industry-standard platforms.
requirements: 1-3+ years of hands-on eDiscovery platform experience (Relativity, 4iG, Canopy, or similar); understanding of EDRM lifecycle, deduplication, and production specifications.

title: Software Engineer
description: Build and maintain internal tools, workflow automation pipelines, and data integration utilities supporting enterprise legal operations and incident response triage.
requirements: Proficiency with modern web stacks (JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, Python, or Go); experience with REST APIs, secure data handling, and automated processing pipelines.

title: Business Operations Associate
description: Coordinate cross-functional project deliverables, client communications, resource tracking, and operational quality assurance across multi-jurisdictional matters.
requirements: Strong organizational and communication skills; experience in project tracking, client operations, or professional services coordination; detail-oriented mindset.
